combinations.name: MAOIs
combinations.description: An MAOI leaves cocaine's catecholamine surge nowhere to go. Blood pressure can spike into a crisis. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Alcohol
combinations.description: Your liver combines the two into **cocaethylene** — a longer-lasting stimulant that strains the heart more than cocaine alone. It feels smoother, so both get redosed further.

combinations.name: Beta-blockers
combinations.description: Not the danger it's rumored to be. The 'unopposed alpha' warning came from case reports; outcome data show no extra harm from beta-blockers after cocaine use. The one real caution is non-selective propranolol during active cocaine chest pain.
